tasks.title: Research models, BaseResearchToolkit mixin & packaging
tasks.parallelism_notes: Foundation. Every other task imports models.py and base.py, and needs the `research` extra this task adds to pyproject.toml. Must complete before anything else starts.

tasks.title: OpenDataToolkit — World Bank methods
tasks.parallelism_notes: Head of the open-data chain (2235>2236>2237), which writes only open_data.py. Runs in a worktree parallel to the academic chain (2238>2241, academic.py). The two chains share no source file; all shared-file edits are deferred to TASK-2243.

tasks.title: OpenDataToolkit — EU Open Data Portal search
tasks.parallelism_notes: Open-data chain. Same file as 2235/2237 so sequential within the chain, but the chain as a whole runs parallel to the academic chain.

tasks.title: OpenDataToolkit — OECD SDMX methods
tasks.parallelism_notes: Tail of the open-data chain. Hardest source (SDMX 3.0, positional dimensions, DSD fetch, unpaginated responses). Closes the chain and, with 2241, unblocks the router.

tasks.title: AcademicResearchToolkit — Crossref search
tasks.parallelism_notes: Head of the academic chain (2238>2239>2240>2241), which writes only academic.py. Runs in a worktree parallel to the open-data chain. Also covers Oxford Academic content via DOI prefix 10.1093.

tasks.title: AcademicResearchToolkit — PubMed search
tasks.parallelism_notes: Academic chain. Same file as 2238/2240/2241 so sequential within the chain. Only source with a mandatory two-call workflow and hard documented rate limits.

tasks.title: AcademicResearchToolkit — Semantic Scholar & arXiv
tasks.parallelism_notes: Academic chain. Two small sources grouped: S2 is plain aiohttp, arXiv is a port of existing arxiv_tool.py logic (original must stay unmodified).

tasks.title: AcademicResearchToolkit — get_paper_details resolver
tasks.parallelism_notes: Tail of the academic chain. Dispatches across the three identifier-addressable sources built in 2238-2240, so it must come last. Closes the chain and, with 2237, unblocks the router.

tasks.title: ResearchRouter — cross-category dispatch tool
tasks.parallelism_notes: Join point: imports both toolkits, so it waits for both chains. Carries the two AbstractTool traps found in spec review (mandatory explicit args_schema; no bot back-reference for the LLM).

tasks.title: Integration & discovery — exports, TOOL_REGISTRY, CI green
tasks.parallelism_notes: Sole owner of every shared file (research/__init__.py, parrot_tools/__init__.py). This is why 2235-2242 could run in parallel worktrees. Also regenerates TOOL_REGISTRY, without which CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml:30 --check) fails.

tasks.title: Documentation — docs/research_tools.md
tasks.parallelism_notes: Last. Documents the shipped surface, so it must run after exports and the registry are final to avoid documenting names that changed.
